                ⭐ Points & Resources

                Karma and Sinister Plot Points are unlocked by the Heroic or Villainous tags. Add one of those tags in the Traits section to activate your resource pool.
                Add the Heroic tag to activate
                Karma is earned through heroic deeds and spent to improve abilities or re-roll dice. Starting Karma = Rank.
                Add the Villainous tag to activate
                Sinister Plot Points fuel villainous schemes and power boosts. Starting SPP = Rank.

                🎓 Getting Schooled

                Working toward Rank 2 0 / 10
                Check a box after every ⚔ major adventure using your powers against a foe of equal or higher rank, or after 📚 training (e.g. Danger Room). Rule: You cannot check two training boxes in a row — an adventure must come between each training check.

                ⚙ Iconic Items

                Iconic items grant powers and cost power picks equal to their Power Value (power picks granted − restrictions, minimum 1). Numbered powers count by their number, restrictions reduce Power Value, and Tech/Magic Reliance is tracked separately.

                No iconic items yet. Use Build / Edit to create one.

                ✏ Editing:
                Official Iconic Item Math: Power Value = granted power picks + item-specific powers − restrictions, minimum 1. Numbered powers count by tier. Owned items require the matching Iconic Item power; borrowed items simply grant powers while restrictions are met.
                Power Value: 1
                Costs this many power picks to own. Powers you already have don't count.

                ⚠️ Running from a local file on Windows?
                Chrome may block scripts in downloaded HTML files. To fix:
                Right-click the file → Properties → tick Unblock at the bottom → OK. Then reopen.

                🗡 Team Maneuvers

                Heroes (or villains) on the same team can use one special group maneuver per battle. Pick a type at the start of the adventure. Activate only at the start of a round. Each participant must be within 5 spaces of another participant, able to communicate, and pay Focus (or 1 Karma).
                Browse & Filter Maneuvers
                Rules reminder
                • Team = at least 2 characters. No upper limit.
                • A character on multiple teams may only join one team maneuver per battle.
                • Outsiders don’t benefit unless they declare a team-up for the adventure.
                • Choose type at adventure start; switch only once per day (at HQ / safe strategy talk).
                • Lower level of the same type is always allowed (pay the lower cost).
                • Unconscious/demoralized members need not join; if they can pay, they may still benefit.
                • Villain teams can use these too.
                • Focus costs scale with level — edit defaults in the panel if your table differs.
                🎲 MARVEL DICE ROLLER
                +0
                Edge / Trouble: Edge rerolls the lowest die; Trouble rerolls the highest. Edges and Troubles cancel 1-for-1 before you roll.

                Marvel Multiverse Role-Playing Game
                The Bullpen
                M616 Hero Database & Combat Tracker

                Your all-in-one companion for the Marvel Multiverse RPG — build heroes, run fights, and roll dice, all in one place.

                🦸 Character Creator
                380+ powers · 100+ traits · 60+ tags · Origins & occupations with auto bonuses · Negative ability scores · Free Mode for no-limits builds
                ⚙ Homebrew Workshops
                Build custom powers, traits, tags & origins — with optional stat modifiers that update Defense & OOC live. Narrator approval badges included.
                🗡 Iconic Items
                Design unique items with a Power Value system — choose powers, set restrictions, track reliance. Items auto-add the Iconic Item power when equipped.
                🔍 Origin Browser
                Browse all official origins & occupations with full detail cards. Build custom origins and save them to your vault for reuse.
                ⚔ Combat Tracker
                Initiative order · HP & Focus bars · Bonus & main action rounds · 12 tap-to-toggle condition chips (Stunned, Prone, Grabbed & more) · Per-turn power reference
                🎲 Ability Check Roller
                Pick a stat — modifier fills in from your sheet. Set Edge or Trouble. Compare against a defense score or fixed TN for instant Hit / Miss / Fantastic results.
                💾 Hero Vault & PDF Export
                Save unlimited characters, overwrite or add new entries. Export polished PDFs in multiple layouts, including Standard, Showcase, and the new Dossier format — all stats, powers, traits & iconic items included.
                📊 Live Stat Calculations
                Defense, OOC & damage multipliers update instantly. Run, fly, swim & jump speeds auto-calculated. Health DR, Focus DR & initiative all tracked.
                "Excelsior!"

(function(){ function canShare() { return !!(navigator.share && /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent)); } // Helper: share or download a text blob function shareOrDownload(filename, content, mimeType) { if(canShare()) { try { const file = new File([content], filename, { type: mimeType }); if(navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) { navigator.share({ files: [file], title: filename }) .catch(err => { if(err.name !== 'AbortError') console.warn('Share failed:', err); }); return; } } catch(e) { /* fall through to anchor download */ } } // Desktop / fallback try { const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType }); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = filename; a.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 5000); } catch(e) { if(typeof showAlert === 'function') { showAlert('Download failed: ' + e.message + '\n\nTry the "Export JSON" option and copy the text manually.', 'Download Error', '⚠️'); } } } // Patch exportHero (single character JSON export) const _origExportHero = window.exportHero; window.exportHero = function() { if(!canShare()) { if(typeof _origExportHero === 'function') _origExportHero(); return; } try { const data = JSON.stringify(collectHero(), null, 2); const name = (document.getElementById('heroName').value || 'hero').replace(/\\s+/g, '_'); shareOrDownload(name + '.json', data, 'application/json'); } catch(e) { if(typeof _origExportHero === 'function') _origExportHero(); } }; // Patch exportVaultBulk (bulk JSON export) const _origExportVaultBulk = window.exportVaultBulk; window.exportVaultBulk = function(scope) { if(!canShare()) { if(typeof _origExportVaultBulk === 'function') _origExportVaultBulk(scope); return; } try { const heroes = getVault(); const list = scope === 'all' ? heroes : heroes; // folder filtering is in original fn if(!list || !list.length) { showAlert('No characters to export.', 'Empty Vault', '📦'); return; } const label = scope === 'all' ? 'all' : scope; const payload = { source: 'BullpenExport', exportDate: new Date().toISOString(), characters: list }; shareOrDownload('bullpen_' + label + '_' + list.length + '_characters.json', JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), 'application/json'); } catch(e) { if(typeof _origExportVaultBulk === 'function') _origExportVaultBulk(scope); } }; // Patch roll history text/JSON downloads const _origDownloadText = window.downloadText; window.downloadText = function(filename, content, type) { shareOrDownload(filename, content, type || 'text/plain'); }; // Make shareOrDownload globally accessible (used by bakeAndDownload below) window._bullpenShareOrDownload = shareOrDownload; })(); // ── END Android share-sheet shim ───────────────────────────────────────────── // ── Android hardware back-button handler ───────────────────────────────────── // In Capacitor, the hardware back button fires 'backbutton' on document. // Without this, it exits the app instead of closing open modals/panels. (function(){ const MODAL_IDS = [ 'exportModal', 'welcomeModal', 'customThemeBuilderModal', 'narratorModal', 'partyOverviewModal' ]; function closeTopModal() { for(const id of MODAL_IDS) { const el = document.getElementById(id); if(el && el.style.display !== 'none' && el.style.display !== '') { el.style.display = 'none'; return true; } } // Close any open
                that are in a modal-like panel const openDetails = document.querySelectorAll('details[open]'); if(openDetails.length) { openDetails[openDetails.length - 1].open = false; return true; } return false; } // Capacitor back button event document.addEventListener('backbutton', function(e) { if(closeTopModal()) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); } // If no modal was open, let Capacitor handle it (exits app or navigates back) }, false); // Also handle popstate for WebView history navigation window.addEventListener('popstate', function() { closeTopModal(); }); })(); // ── END back-button handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── // ── Auto-activate Mobile Lite mode on small screens ────────────────────────── (function(){ const STYLE_KEY = 'bullpen_ui_style_v1'; function autoActivateMobile() { // Only auto-set on very first visit (no stored preference) const stored = (function(){ try { return localStorage.getItem(STYLE_KEY); } catch(e){ return null; } })(); if(stored) return; // user has chosen a style — respect their choice const isSmall = window.innerWidth <= 600 || /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent); // App shell owns layout — do not enable mobile-lite section hiding if(isSmall && typeof setBullpenUIStyle === 'function') { setBullpenUIStyle('classic');
